using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode; public class InspectAnimators { public static string Run() { NetworkManager nm = Object.FindObjectOfType<NetworkManager>(true); if (nm == null || nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab == null) return "No PlayerPrefab"; GameObject prefab = nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab; Animator[] anims = prefab.GetComponentsInChildren<Animator>(true); string res = $"Found {anims.Length} Animators:
"; foreach(var a in anims) { res += $"- {a.gameObject.name} (Root: {a.gameObject == prefab})
"; } var cna = prefab.GetComponent<Unity.Netcode.Components.NetworkAnimator>(); if (cna != null) res += $"
NetworkAnimator points to: {(cna.Animator != null ? cna.Animator.gameObject.name : "NULL")}"; return res; } }
